<!-- deps: 3012 -->
Cannot start #3017 because its pattern folder prerequisite, #3012, is not available.

Main is at `d911f45535df24c42d5fde5feaed386c5fca4907`.
It has no `PatternDef`, pattern folder commands, or expanded pattern posting.
Issue #3012 is open and has the `blocked` label.
It waits on the CL transforms in #3011.
No open PR for #3012 is available to stack on.

The research in #2938 names #3012 as the prerequisite for #3017.
Without that implementation, a runtime pin cannot compare compact pattern output with expanded pattern output.
Implementing the prerequisite here would exceed the scope of this task.

Overlap checks found #3046 in the post engine and record files, and #3280 in `fanuc.cps`.
Other open PRs touch `posting.rs`.
No pattern function exists to compare for a same-function overlap.

STOPPED: waits on #3012. No claim was made.
No source files, tests, branches, or worktrees were created.
No gate or mutation check ran.

Two more requirements for compact posting:

1. **Cancel at program start.** Also write `G52 X0. Y0. Z0.` (or the dialect equivalent) at the start of the program, before the first move. Do not only cancel before tool changes and at the end. On some controls a local shift from an aborted program stays active until it is cancelled, so the first copy of the next program can cut at the wrong place.
2. **HEIDENHAIN.** The HEIDENHAIN posts have no `G52`/`M98`. Their equivalent is the datum shift cycle (cycle 7, or the datum table) and `CALL LBL` / `CALL PGM`. HEIDENHAIN cancels the coordinate transformation cycles when a new main program is selected, but a cancel at the end of the pattern is still needed inside the program. Until a Klartext form is verified against the published manual, the HEIDENHAIN posts refuse `LocalShift` and `Subprogram` by name (they do not declare the capability).

Done means adds: a golden test that shows the cancel block before the first move.
